title: University Governance and Accreditation: Choosing the Right Passive
goal: Choose accurately among se passive, ser + participle, and estar + participle in academic governance and peer review

items: I can choose accurately among se passive, ser + participle, and estar + participle in academic governance and peer review
I can maintain verb and participle agreement across passive constructions without mixing se passive and a por agent
I can use governance and accreditation vocabulary (el rectorado, la titulación, el currículo, acreditado, impartir, el plagio)
